content.name: Unique Ship Limits
content.description: Switches that lift the build limit on the unique ships: Astrid, Experimental Shuttle, the Boron story corvette and the Timelines racers, plus one that keeps the Erlking research so a second one can be built. Blueprints are still required. Works on an existing savegame.
content.author: drjele
